title: Getting Drunk on the Holy Ghost
description: Get ready to experience a powerful and unconventional message from Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a life-changing revelation about the anointing and the Holy Spirit's presence in our lives. In this sermon, Pastor Chris challenges listeners to place a demand on the anointing and to surround themselves with people who are hungry for God. Join him as he shares a dynamic and Spirit-filled message that will leave you inspired, motivated, and empowered to live a life of radical obedience to God.
